arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) weed: sudden mid-leg drop of push_local (watch drag_jump) -> clear_rudder, check speed recovers; (2) pod drift: pod power vs boat power/HR diverging slowly (watches ratio_up/ratio_down, metric hr_per_pod) -> measure() early clean windows vs now, set pod_gain; (3) current/wind shift: note via legs(); (4) radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell distance; (5) speak rarely: reassure at halfway, tell distance late. Baseline: first clean legs after start.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. Done: weed at 510 s cleared by clear_rudder at 574 s (speed +2.3%). Boat CP set 125 W (test said 116; fit share 0.698 x pod CP 180). Current ~0.07 m/s helps northbound (odd legs). Watch: (1) weed again: drag_jump (push_local drop 0.05 mid-leg) -> ask_paddler then clear_rudder; (2) HR trend at pod ~190: if climbing >1 bpm/min, CP too high -> revise; (3) pod drift via ratio_up/ratio_down + HR; (4) radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell; (5) speak rarely; tell distance late.

arguments.text: min 12.7 RADIO: wind filling from the south 8-12 kn -> tailwind on northbound (odd) legs, headwind on southbound (even) legs, on top of current ~+0.07 north. Expect push_local north > +0.1, south < -0.1. A drag_jump alert on a south leg may be this wind, not weed: check whether it flips on the next leg and ask paddler before clear_rudder. Boat push_along lags -> boat power/reserve biased for a leg or two; pod reserve unaffected.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. Done: weed at 510 s cleared (speed +2.3%); boat CP set 125 W (fit share 0.698 x pod CP 180); wind from south since ~13 min (+0.1 m/s north, -0.1 south) on top of current 0.07 north. EXPERIMENT (critical power): after the turn into leg 4 (south, headwind) run piece +6% for 240 s (pod ~180 -> ~191), test_cost says ~free. Read HR trend over the last 150 s of it with measure(): HR levels (<0.7 bpm/min) -> true pod CP >= ~190: raise critical_power_pod_w and boat CP; HR climbs >1.5 bpm/min -> CP near 180 or lower: keep/lower. Ask paddler at end. Also watch: weed (drag_jump), pod drift (pod_drift_hr), radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

arguments.text: min 23.7 CP TEST RESULT: piece +9% 240 s, pod 194-196 vs 178 before. HR 178.5 -> 185.4; last 90 s trend +0.5 bpm/min (SE 0.5). Paddler 5/10 plenty (says that every time, uninformative). Inconclusive: CP probably 180-190; kept pod CP 180, boat 125. Pod reserve now 15% at CP 180. Late race: if HR flat and well below max at pacer effort ~181, consider small CP raise for the finish; never raise if HR climbing.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back (finish after leg 8, heading south). Pacer owns effort. Done: weed cleared at 574 s; boat CP 125 W; wind from south since 13 min (true push ~0.20 m/s north/-0.20 south; boat push estimate lags at ~0.11); CP test piece (1170-1424 s) inconclusive, CP 180-190, kept 180. Next: watch weed (drag_jump) and pod drift (pod_drift_hr), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell distance). At 1500 m to go: check HR and pod reserve; if HR flat and reserve >10%, a small CP raise lets the pacer spend more at the finish. Tell distance near the end only if useful.
